title: Peach Slices - Smoothing Solution Ingrown Hair Treatment (1.69 oz) - Smooth, Relieve, Soften Skin - 360 Roller - BHA, AHA, PHA, Niacinamide, Licorice - Vegan & Cruelty Free - Korean Skin Care & Beauty

reviews.reviewTitle: PLEASE MAKE A BIGGER SIZE, NEVER STOP MAKING THIS ‼️
reviews.reviewDescription: I purchased this a few months ago back in November 2025 because of all the TikTok hype. It's now June 2026, and even though it's only 50ml, it lasts SO long. A little goes a very long way, and I still haven't finished it yet!! I originally bought this to use after waxing my underarms because I'd always get painful bumps, irritation, itching, and overall discomfort. I'd only apply it at night, and by the next day the bumps and irritation had gone down significantly! Whenever I get bumps, irritation, or discomfort, I use it for about 3 days to a week and it works so fast 😍 I really wish they sold a bigger size because the reviews are not lying💯...this thing works wondersss. It's worth every single dollar. It's also pretty good at targeting ingrown hairs too. Like omg, it's basically a painkiller in a bottle 😂 It has saved the day so many times & I've used this quite a lot, lol.

I've had a difficult time with shaving with sensitive skin. I can use multiple different types of razors, lotions and creams. It doesn't always work well for me. So I saw this mentioned on TikTok and I thought I would give it a go. I'm impressed by how good it calms any irritation or itchiness I may have. It applies on cool and and it's easy to use. It carries no scent. It's a small roll-on and lightweight. It's soothing and moisturizing to the irritated skin. Works like a charm. Would recommend!

This is definitely worth the buy. I’ve tried a couple different products to reduce ingrown hairs and bumps after waxing, and this is the only product I’ve used that’s made a difference. In a weeks time I’ve seen major improvement in my skin. As a big girl, I’m constantly battling with ingrown hairs and I was honestly ready to just give up waxing. The ingrowns I had when I started using it are less angry, my skin feels more moisturized and I can see other healing blemishes getting smaller.

Very good product, not sticky, made my skin feel hydrated, it is very effective and has no scent, the only downside is that while it is good for preventing ingrown hair if used consistently (2x a day on clean skin), it does nothing for pre-existing ingrown hairs.

This is INCREDIBLE! Ok, firstly, let me say that I apply it after shaving and razor burn is a distant memory now. It has also taken down the drastic redness and red marks that previous shaving had left my skin w. My skin is smoother and softer now.. including my bikini area. Not to be tmi but, I have a c section scar, it’s nearly impossible to prevent ingrown hairs in that area bc of the scar tissue .. or so I thought! OMG , I’ll never give this stuff up ! It also helps w my back acne and is easy as pie to apply , doesn’t smell weird and absorbs nicely .. bonus points.. it will tame the zits on your bum too .. but wait .. there’s more ! My super pale sensitive skin on my legs has been forever marked w scars from shaving and always has little red marks besides that so I’ve always been insecure about my legs even though they’re long and strong .. dude .. I kid you not, this has been taking the red marks out and no more razor burns.. or bumps plus all of the scars are starting to fade !! This is a HOLY GRAIL PRODUCT! I had literally quit shaving my legs before this and now.. I’m feeling so much better about it & myself and omg thank you for this product! Never ever stop making it !

Ok so I would take this review with a grain of salt because I feel like the results of this product really just depends on how and when you use it. I received my peach slices roller after I already shaved so I’ve been using it as my hair is growing back. And what I can say is … it doesn’t make the ingrowns and all the marks go away, but it definitely makes them appear lighter and they’re not as prominent. However, if I had used this either before or during shaving, I might have gotten a different result. So , as far as it being effective, it’s really the difference between preventing the ingrown and then making them go away. but it’s very smooth and easy to use has a pretty neutral smell.
